name: multi-model-cell03-provider-execution-authorization-unlock
title: Unlock Cell 03 provider execution authorization with bounded spend and bound execution metadata
description: Cell 03 is the next formal M2-a provider execution step, but current artifacts keep providerExecutionAuthorized=false because exact bounded budget approval, dated model snapshots, prompt/tool digests, runner ownership, duplicate policy, result write policy, execution window, and Cell 03-only scope are not yet bound. This story records and verifies those prerequisites while rejecting uncapped approval and avoiding later-cell execution or broader claim rows.
